result.topic_en: A table listing the primes p ≡ 1 (mod 4) from 89 to 197, each with an associated number n and a signed even number b; each b matches the even part of p as a sum of two squares.

methods.what: Table of primes p ≡ 1 (mod 4) from 89 to 197 with associated values n and signed b; each |b| is the even component in p = a^2 + b^2
